comments.author: @BestHiddenPlaces
comments.text:
In Douala, nearly 12 feet of rain falls in an average year, yet fewer than half of its homes can count on a reliable tap close by. ☔🚰
If you lived in Cameroon for a week, which would you miss first: the city bus, the tap at home, or small change in your pocket?

comments.author: @WherePeopleLive8386
comments.text: The irony of taps running dry in a city soaked by rain really stayed with me - all that water falling from the sky while families still queue for every drop. It says so much about how daily life here actually works.

replies.author: @BestHiddenPlaces
replies.text: Exactly. The rain isn't the problem, the pipes are. Water has to be treated and delivered, and that's where Douala falls short.
